type.description: 'food' is eaten from the item menu (its stats say what it gives); an 'ingredient' is only cooked with; a 'tool' works the farm from the item button (its stats name which tool it is).

icon.description: The item's picture (a frame of gameplay/art/items.png, ItemIcons.FRAMES). Without one, its type decides.

stats.description: Weapon stats. Damage is in enemy health points; ranged weapons name their ammo item id and arrow speed (px/s); bombs have a fuse (s) and blast radius (px); a lantern's radius is how far its light reaches (px).

energy.description: Food: the energy it gives when eaten.

hearts.description: Food: the hearts it mends when eaten (0.5 is half a heart).

tool.description: A tool: 'hoe' tills bare soil; 'water' is the watering can, which waters tilled soil and names what it holds as its 'ammo' (that item's max_stack is how many pours it holds). 'cooldown' is how long one use takes (s).
